statement:
I'll look up the payment details first.
The record shows the membership as active and renewing, but Tomas cancelled this membership in writing on July 3rd and received email confirmation from Fitline. I will refuse this payment.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "active, renewing" status contradicts the stated facts — "Tomas cancelled this membership in writing on July 3rd and received email confirmation" — and refuses the payment.
